# Tests the main CI job is expected to skip, one unittest id per line. The runner
# (.github/scripts/run_tests.py) fails on any other skip and on any listed test that runs.
# The Docling groups need the pinned Docling runtime and test_office_runtime.RealRuntimeTests the pinned
# LibreOffice runtime; .github/workflows/docling.yml and libreoffice.yml provision them and run with an
# empty skip set. The sandbox tests (bwrap, unshare) are not listed: CI installs bubblewrap and enables
# unprivileged namespaces, so they must run.
